title: ACE-RLHF: Automated Code Evaluation and Socratic Feedback Generation Tool using Large Language Models and Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical and pedagogical performance of LLMs in generating Socratic feedback for programming students. It uses metrics like BLEU, ROUGE, and student surveys on fluency and relevancy. There is no evaluation of religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
